name: Media Contextual Crop Reference
description: Provides an solution to contextualize crop in media referenced fields
project_description:
This module provides a way to ability to apply a contextual crop to referenced media in entity reference fields

 Requirements 
 Module Media Contextual Crop API 

At leat one of the adapters :

 
 Media Contextual Crop FocalPoint Adapter 
 Media Contextual Crop ImageWidgetCrop Adapter 
 
 Versions 
 2.0.x Branch 
 - Fully compatible with Media_contextual_crop 2.0.x release

- Remove all Drupal 9 compatibilities

- Ensure cleaning of crop & derivative when host entity are deleted

 1.3.x 
 The 1.3.x branch are compatible with 1.2.x branch of main module in order to make it compatible with the core responsive_image formatter

 1.x to 2.x Update process 
 
 Use Drupal 10 
 Upgrade this module to 1.3.0 
 Upgrade all media_contextual_crop collection modules on the same row to 2.x 
 Carefully read the recommendations on the module media_contextual_crop
